q: The verifier asks for production records. What format do they need?
title: Production records for the verifier
short: Monthly output in the same unit as your intensity figure, from a source that can be cross-checked, such as dispatch registers, sales invoices or GST returns. Stock changes should reconcile. A spreadsheet is fine if it traces to these documents.
audience: MSMEs preparing production data for verification

ul: Dispatch or sales records that match.

p: Verifiers often compare production with GST returns or excise records. Explain differences such as job work or returns.
Use one unit throughout: tonnes, pieces or square metres, with conversion factors written down.

senseible: Senseible keeps each record with its source document, fingerprint, factor and method version, so a verifier can trace any figure back to the bill it came from.

sources.label: ISO 14064-3, validation and verification of GHG statements
